title: Immunization Services Training Casebook: Positions Held by Matched Registry Copies
content:
**Rule taught in this module.** For an Immunization Services dose posted to a course, where the number is counted from positions, matched registry copies hold positions as follows: 0 positions each where Kestrel reported a dose of the course, 1 position between them where it reported none and a documented cash-paid outside entry exists, and one each otherwise.

A matched registry copy is a plan-billed dose entry recorded from another provider (it names no Kestrel store and is billed to a pharmacy benefit) that has been matched as a copy of Kestrel's report to the state registry. A documented cash-paid outside entry is a cash-paid dose entry naming no Kestrel store that carries a lot number.

## Questions answered

**Q. Kestrel's registry report of a dose is on the course. How many positions do the matched registry copies hold?**
None: each holds 0 positions, however many there are.

**Q. There is no Kestrel registry report on the course, but a cash-paid entry from another provider with a lot number is on it. What do the matched copies hold?**
Together they hold 1 position. It is one position between all of them, not one each; where no copy is matched, they hold none.

**Q. There is no Kestrel registry report and no documented cash-paid outside entry. What then?**
Each matched registry copy holds one position.

## Casebook (hypothetical courses)

| Hypothetical course | Kestrel registry report on the course | Documented cash-paid outside entry | Matched registry copies | Positions they hold |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | Yes | Yes or no | 2 | 0 |
| B | No | Yes | 2 | 1 |
| C | No | Yes | 1 | 1 |
| D | No | No | 2 | 2 |
| E | No | No | 0 | 0 |

The first matching row decides: where Kestrel's registry report is on the course, the presence of a documented cash-paid outside entry does not change the result.
